summary: DIRECTV FOR BUSINESS provides commercial live-TV and sports programming (satellite/streaming) to bars and restaurants; it is a facility/entertainment vendor, not a POS, payments, or back-office competitor to Genius. (Scope note: Product/marketing page, not a dated press release.)

DIRECTV for Business partnered with BYOD to add AI-powered scheduling to its hospitality entertainment offering, part of an expanded 2026 sports lineup (Apple TV F1, MLS Season Pass, expanded Prime Video Sports). (Scope note: Exact publication day not confirmed; company's own blog rather than independent press coverage.)

DIRECTV's own commissioned survey found 90% of bar/restaurant operators rated premium sports packages good-to-excellent for increasing customer dwell time (June 2025 national survey of 300 operators). (Scope note: Vendor-commissioned survey, not independent research; no restaurant brand names disclosed.)
